tempDirName_comment: The sandbox must not live in a dot directory. Rule matching goes through picomatch, whose ** does not cross a segment starting with a dot, so a sandbox under .stryker-tmp silently changes what the fixture integration test sees.
disableTypeChecks_comment: Stryker adds a @ts-nocheck banner to every sandbox file by default. That rewrites tests/fixtures/basic-project and shifts the line numbers the fixture integration test asserts on. Vitest transpiles without type checking, so the banner is not needed here.
